name: Hotzonex WiFi
location: EDIT ME: e.g. Juba, near Konyo Konyo market
hours: EDIT ME: e.g. 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM every day
payment_methods: EDIT ME: e.g. Cash at the counter
how_to_connect: Turn on WiFi on your phone and pick the Hotzonex network.
A login page opens automatically (if not, open any website in your browser).
Enter the voucher code you bought and tap Connect.
troubleshooting: Login page does not open: open http://neverssl.com in the browser to trigger it.
Voucher says 'already used': each code works on one device at a time; log out on the other device or ask staff.
Connected but no internet: turn WiFi off and on, forget the network and reconnect, and make sure mobile data saver/VPN is off.
Very slow: move closer to the access point; speeds drop at peak hours in the evening.
policies: Vouchers are not refundable once used.
Lost vouchers cannot be replaced unless the receipt is shown.
